memory_availability: Only label_available_date strictly before issuance close date. Sample keys use input eligibility, not future outcome presence. Neighbor votes aggregate by source date before smoothing.
router_availability: Issue predictions for ALL eligible inputs first. Update each frozen past batch once, only after ALL batch outcomes are known strictly before current date. Missing batch outcomes delay updates, never partial-score them.
controls: Same frozen Extra Trees and calibration for all methods, case memory alone, recent date prior alone, fixed uniform average, adaptive mixture, momentum and random. Adaptive must not win merely by becoming the recent prior.
evaluation_role: Prequential HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT replay. Earlier evaluation outcomes may enter memory and router only after actual label availability. NOT a static heldout model or independent new validation.
